retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban collage featuring a central subject atop a large speaker, surrounded by desaturated, hand-sketched scrapbook elements and vibrant red spray-paint accents.
triggerTerms: desaturated photo collage with red accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure sits atop a large black studio monitor speaker. The background is a textured, light-gray canvas filled with a chaotic but balanced arrangement of desaturated polaroid-style photos, rough pencil sketches, and scribbled icons like broken hearts. A hazy red glow emanates from behind the central figure, and the bottom of the frame is littered with dark, petal-like debris.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject anchored by a large geometric object (speaker)
Desaturated peripheral imagery contrasting with a saturated central red glow
Rough, hand-drawn charcoal lines framing photographic elements
Vertical hierarchy with the subject at the apex and debris at the base
coreInvariants: Textured light-gray background with visible paper or plaster grain
Red as the sole high-chroma accent color
Rough, sketchy charcoal or pencil borders around secondary images

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale figure sitting on a speaker that occupies the bottom-middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black speaker cabinet provides a heavy, dark base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure's face, moves down to the speaker, then spirals outward to the surrounding collage elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the 'empty' areas are filled with subtle textures and light pencil scribbles.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light gray and off-white (background and texture)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark charcoal (speaker, shadows, and sketches)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background vs. low value, medium saturation subject vs. high saturation accents.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a physical paint brush
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated into the side of the speaker cabinet
Dripping or spray-painted texture on the glyphs

composition.position: lower right of the central object
composition.relationshipToImage: placed on the surface of the speaker

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hand-written script paired with small, clean sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, hand-painted aesthetic of the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gritty urban collage on a light gray textured background. Place a central figure sitting on a large black speaker. Surround them with desaturated photos and charcoal sketches. Add a red hazy glow behind the figure and dark petals on the floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-painted red brush lettering to the side of the speaker cabinet with a distressed, slightly dripping texture.

verificationChecks: Is the red glow concentrated behind the central figure?
Are the peripheral images desaturated and framed with rough sketches?
Is the text integrated onto the speaker surface?

adjustableVariables: Density of the background collage elements
Amount of debris on the floor
mustRedesign: Brand logos on clothing or equipment

mustAchieve: Cohesive desaturated color palette with one strong accent
Balanced chaos in the background elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red accent is vibrant and not muddy.
Ensure the charcoal sketches look hand-drawn, not filtered.
Verify the central figure is the clear focal point.
Confirm the background texture is visible and consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Large dark anchor object + Desaturated scrapbook collage + Red atmospheric glow + Hand-drawn charcoal accents.
